literal: Proportional to the water's depth is the flower's stem length; proportional to their own mind's strength is people's greatness.
translation: The length of a water-lily's stem is proportional to the depth of the water; even so, the height of a person's greatness is proportional to the strength of their inner drive.
modern: நீரின் ஆழத்திற்கு ஏற்ப நீர்வாழ்பூக்களின் தண்டு வளரும்; அதுபோல, மனிதர்களின் ஊக்கத்தின் அளவிற்கு ஏற்ப அவர்களுடைய உயர்வு அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful natural analogy to explain how inner motivation determines human achievement. The poet points out that the stems of aquatic flowers like lilies grow longer or shorter to match the exact depth of the water they are in. Similarly, the height of a person's greatness is not fixed, but rises in direct proportion to the depth of their determination and enthusiasm. By pairing 'வெள்ளத்து' (of the water) with 'உள்ளத்து' (of the mind), the verse shows that our external success is always a reflection of our internal drive.
